pain_points: calls go to voicemail after 5pm and at lunch, the front desk is overwhelmed, and missed calls mean missed new patients
product: an AI receptionist that answers every call, books appointments and texts confirmations
objections: first, it's too expensive for a small office; second, we tried a phone bot two years ago and patients hated it; third, I can't decide this without Dr. Patel
